display_long_description:
You are the night shift quality control inspector inside an old doll manufacturing plant.

Your job is simple: inspect the dolls, approve production, and finish your shift.

But something isn’t right.

Dolls appear where you didn’t leave them.
Machinery activates on its own.
Footsteps echo through empty corridors.

In this immersive VR horror role-playing experience, you must complete your shift while a series of disturbing events unfold around you. The factory feels alive — and it’s watching.

Explore dark assembly lines, storage rooms filled with rejected dolls, and silent inspection stations as tension builds hour by hour.

Features:

First-person VR horror experience

Story-driven night shift role play

Atmospheric doll factory setting

360° spatial audio immersion

Designed for Meta Quest

Can you finish your shift… or become part of the factory?
